Name: Loop One Wireless
Short description: Over-ear wireless headphones with adaptive noise cancelling.
Details: 40 mm beryllium-coated drivers, 38 h battery with ANC on, USB-C fast charge (10 min = 6 h), Bluetooth 5.3 with LDAC and aptX Adaptive, multipoint to two devices. Memory-foam earpads in lambskin, replaceable without tools. 268 g.

Name: Loop Studio Pro
Short description: Open-back studio headphones for mixing at home.
Details: 45 mm dynamic drivers, 32 ohm, 10 Hz–40 kHz. Open-back for a wide stage; not for noisy rooms. Detachable 3 m cable, 6.35 mm and 3.5 mm leads. Velour pads. 295 g.

Name: Loop Air 2
Short description: In-ear buds with hybrid ANC and a case that charges twice over.
Details: 11 mm drivers, 7 h a charge and 28 h with the case, IPX5, wireless charging, four ear-tip sizes. Transparency mode you can hold a conversation through.

Name: Loop Air 2 Sport
Short description: The Air 2 with a wing tip, for running.
Details: Same drivers as the Air 2 with a silicone wing that holds through a long run. IPX7, rinseable. 6 h a charge, 24 h with the case.

Name: Harbour 200 Bookshelf
Short description: Powered bookshelf speakers for a desk or a small room.
Details: 130 W a pair, 5.25 in woven-fibre woofer and 1 in silk-dome tweeter, HDMI ARC, optical, RCA and Bluetooth aptX HD. Real walnut cabinets, 320 × 185 × 240 mm each. Remote and stands included.

Name: Harbour Mini
Short description: One small speaker that fills a kitchen.
Details: 60 W, 4 in woofer with twin passive radiators, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, AirPlay 2 and Spotify Connect. Pair two for stereo. 180 × 120 × 130 mm.

Name: Harbour Field
Short description: A portable speaker that survives the beach.
Details: IP67, 20 h battery, USB-C out to charge a phone, 50 W with a passive radiator each side. Strap included. 790 g.

Name: Harbour 500 Floorstander
Short description: Floorstanding speakers for a proper listening room.
Details: Three-way, twin 6.5 in woofers, 180 W a channel, room correction over USB. 1020 × 220 × 310 mm, 24 kg each. Delivered on a pallet, two-person lift.

Name: Tether USB-C DAC
Short description: A pocket DAC that drives any headphone from a phone.
Details: ES9038Q2M, up to 32-bit/768 kHz and DSD512, 3.5 mm and 4.4 mm balanced out, 125 mW into 32 ohm. Aluminium, 28 g.

Name: Loop Cable Kit
Short description: Three braided cables that fit everything we sell.
Details: 1.2 m 3.5 mm, 3 m 6.35 mm and a 1.5 m USB-C to USB-C, oxygen-free copper, fabric braid, two-year warranty. In a zip case.

Name: Memory Foam Earpads
Short description: Replacement pads for the Loop One and Studio Pro.
Details: Lambskin or velour, memory foam, twist-lock mount. Swap them in under a minute; no tools.

Name: Desk Stand
Short description: A weighted aluminium stand for a pair of headphones.
Details: Anodised aluminium with a felt cradle and a 1.4 kg base, cable channel at the back. Holds any over-ear pair.
